title: Turn job planning on in athena.toml and record the decision
summary: Job 5b of docs/design/job-planning.md: add [job_plan] (enabled, 0.75 caps, 600 s timeouts, max_rounds 3) to athena.toml, make the CLI test config strip that section so existing tests keep the unplanned path, and log the decision (alternatives, keep rule, reversal) in docs/decisions.md. The audience is the owner and the verifier, who check the config parses and the tests still pass.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria require cargo test, clippy and fmt to pass.
The test criterion checks that the config parses and that existing tests pass without the section.
The decision entry must cite design sections and give the numbers.
One focused config change with its test helper and docs.
The repo-config test enforces that athena.toml parses.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Section numbers and figures are taken from the request; I did not read docs/design/job-planning.md, and the producer must check it.
athena.toml has no [job_plan] now; common/mod.rs test_config builds from it by slicing, so the producer must strip the new section there.
The next decision number follows D109 in docs/decisions.md.
The installed binary reads [job_plan], so it accepts the new section.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml has a [job_plan] section with enabled = true, planner_usd = 0.75, critic_usd = 0.75, planner_timeout_s = 600, critic_timeout_s = 600 and max_rounds = 3 (no unknown fields; the schema is deny_unknown_fields).

Run `cargo test --locked`: the repo-config test in athena-data parses athena.toml with [job_plan] enabled, and every existing test passes, including crates/athena-cli/tests, with the test config's [job_plan] dropped.

crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs test_config() removes the [job_plan] section from the athena.toml text it includes, so tests that append their own [job_plan] (job_plan.rs) still work and others take the unplanned path. It works wherever the section sits in athena.toml.

docs/decisions.md has a new numbered entry that turns planning on: the alternatives from section 7 of docs/design/job-planning.md, the keep rule from section 9 (metric: landed share of dispatched change jobs, baseline 64%; hold through 30 planned jobs unless it falls; decide at 100 jobs on 72% and a $2.50 cost ceiling per landed job), and the reversal (set enabled = false). It cites the design.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for turning job planning on, naming athena.toml.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`; both pass. Run `cargo test --locked` including xtask's boundary test; it passes.
The planning stage's code is unchanged: no file under crates/ other than the test helper in athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs differs.

out_of_scope: Changing the planner, critic or planning stage code
Changing the thresholds or measurement design in the design doc
Evaluating the keep rule: no jobs are measured in this change
